What Petto does

Everything your server needs, in one bot

Moderation that remembers, protection that reacts on its own, tickets, levels, giveaways and 19 lookups of other services. The screenshots below show how it looks in Discord.

Moderation that keeps the history

Ban, kick, mute and warn with a case for each one, notes on members and a message to the member that you can write yourself.

  • Cases and notes you can search later, and a list of the sanctions that are still active
  • Timed bans and mutes, softban and a hardban that only the owner and the admins can undo
  • The message to the member, the reply and the log of every sanction can be redesigned
  • Public appeals: the member answers a form on a page and the team decides in Discord
!ban!mute!warn!cases!notes

Protection that acts before you do

Raids, nukes and scams are stopped by the bot while the staff is away, and every action is logged.

  • Anti-raid and anti-nuke with their own settings for each protection, and a lockdown you can start with one command
  • Anti-scam for the same message sent in many channels and for brand new accounts
  • Automod with ready-made rules, your own filters and strikes that grow into a punishment
  • A honeypot channel that catches the accounts that write where nobody should
!lockdown!automod!antinuke!honeypot

Verification that checks and keeps almost nothing

New members pass a check before they can talk: a captcha, a code sent to their email, or both, with extra checks that you turn on one by one.

  • The check: a captcha from Cloudflare, letters in a picture (on a page or inside Discord), or only a code sent to the member’s email, with no captcha
  • Extra checks, each one off, tell the staff or block: Tor, alt accounts, and the age, avatar and flags of the Discord account
  • For the email code the member types an address, or presses “Use my Discord email” and logs in with Discord; only well-known providers are accepted (no + aliases, no throwaway emails)
  • The panel and the DM are cards you can read at a glance; the DM can be turned off when the server has a panel, and a member who already verified is not asked again because of a role
  • What we do not keep: Petto does not save emails or IP addresses. The email is only used to send the code (an email provider, Resend, delivers it), the code lives in memory for ten minutes, and the Discord login reads the email once and drops the access. The Cloudflare captcha is handled by Cloudflare under its own policy
  • What we do keep: that a member passed, and when, so a link works only once; and, only if you turn on the alt accounts check, a coded fingerprint of the IP and of the email for 90 days, which cannot be turned back into either
!verify setup!verify checks!verify channel!verify send

Tickets with a panel of your own

Members open a private channel with the team; you choose how the panel looks, who answers and when.

  • Panels you can design, schedule and limit, with priority, notes and transfer between staff members
  • A welcome message and a channel name that use the member’s data
  • The transcript is kept when the ticket closes
!ticket!close!claim

Levels, ranks and rewards

Text and voice XP with the protections that stop people from farming it, and a rank card for each member.

  • Role rewards by level, multipliers by role, channel or category, and weekly and monthly boards
  • Rank card and level-up message you can design, with a card image
  • The level can also be the requirement of a giveaway, with bonus entries
!rank!top!level

Giveaways that are fair

Start one in seconds, ask for what you want and let the bot pick the winners.

  • A required level (text or voice) and a time for the winners to claim the prize
  • Bonus entries by role or by level, reroll, and messages for the winner that you write
  • Presets and saved designs so the next one takes one command
!giveaway start!giveaway quick!giveaway reroll

19 lookups of other services

Members can look up songs, servers, profiles and prices without leaving Discord, with the same short commands everywhere.

  • Music: Last.fm now playing with the cover, Deezer and iTunes
  • Games: Minecraft servers and players, Roblox, Steam, Chess.com, Modrinth
  • Creators and code: Twitch, YouTube, GitHub, npm and PyPI packages
  • Anime, movies, Pokémon, Wikipedia, crypto and currency conversion
!np!deezer!mc!gh!currency!anime
All commands

Notifications from everywhere

Petto posts in a channel what an account of another service publishes: videos, live streams, music, posts and new versions. We are working hard to bring more services every week.

  • Live streams and videos: YouTube, Twitch and Kick, with the real start time and the picture of the stream
  • Music and podcasts: Spotify, Deezer and Apple Music: an artist, a playlist, the charts, or the link of a song
  • Social: Bluesky, Mastodon, Reddit, Tumblr, Pinterest and Letterboxd, and any website with an RSS feed
  • Code and games: GitHub, npm, PyPI, Modrinth (versions and new mods, plugins or shaders in one feed), Steam, AniList and the free games of Epic Games
  • The Pokémon, an article of Wikipedia, a chess puzzle, a random song from Deezer, Apple Music or Spotify, pictures of the animals you pick in one feed, or pictures of the tags you write, like pink, from every 5 minutes up to once a day, as you choose
  • Up to 5 accounts of each platform on Free servers and 25 on Premium, a preview of the real card and a test button
!feed add!feed list!feed test

A community that feels alive

The small things that make a server yours.

  • Welcome messages in the channel and by DM
  • Birthdays, polls, suggestions, confessions and a starboard
  • Counters, a counting game and voice channels the members control
  • Partners, uploads and a public leaderboard page
  • Role quotas: ask a role for a number of messages in each period, and Petto takes the role away from who misses it too many times in a row
!birthday!poll!suggest!starboard

Statistics and analysis you can trust

See what happens in your server and compare it with the period before: trends, the busiest hours of the week, the top channels and members, how the server grows and how long members stay.

  • Line charts of messages, voice time and active members, each against the period before, with the change in percent
  • A heat map of the week by hour, the top channels and members with their share, and the channels that stayed quiet
  • Growth: who joins, who leaves and how long the ones who left had stayed, plus the page of one member with their streak and place
  • Privacy first: only counts, never what is written. Any member can stop being counted with one button, and a server can turn counting off or delete it all
!stats!stats heatmap!stats @member!stats privacy!statsconfig

Make it yours

Write your own commands, build messages visually and keep every setting in a dashboard.

  • Petto Code: your own commands with embeds, buttons, forms and saved data
  • Embed Builder for embeds and Components V2 messages, with a live preview
  • Custom prefix for the server, and one of your own for each person
!customcommand!prefix
